description: This file defines a mock class for the ISessionServerAppManager interface used in unit testing within the rialto server manager component. It includes mock method declarations for session server management operations.

classes.name: SessionServerAppManagerMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the ISessionServerAppManager interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: preloadSessionServers
methods.description: Mocks the method to preload a specified number of session servers.

methods.name: initiateApplication
methods.description: Mocks the method to initiate an application with a given name, session server state, and app configuration.

methods.name: setSessionServerState
methods.description: Mocks the method to set the state of a session server identified by a string.

methods.name: onSessionServerStateChanged
methods.description: Mocks the callback for when a session server's state changes.

methods.name: sendPingEvents
methods.description: Mocks the method to send ping events with a specified ping ID.

methods.name: onAck
methods.description: Mocks the acknowledgment handling method for server ID, ping ID, and success flag.

methods.name: getAppConnectionInfo
methods.description: Mocks the method to retrieve application connection information based on app name.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Mocks the method to set logging levels.
